evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing has started. Rep first confirms address/apartment details, asks about special considerations (gun safe), big furniture, packing help, then says 'Before I kind of hop in here. However, rep then immediately launches into logistics (access, parking, stairs) before any concerns are fully explored. Agenda question comes early but probing begins in parallel without waiting for a full answer.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer never raised a concern during Section 2. The 'any top of mind concerns' question was asked early, customer said 'No, not off the top of my head,' and rep moved forward. N/A condition met.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection delivered. Customer said no concerns; no summary reflection was offered. N/A condition met.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type: one bedroom apartment; floor/stories: first floor (both); walking distance/access: stairs vs. sidewalk walk at origin, flat straight across at destination; additional considerations: gun safe, large furniture (bed, dresser, couch, kayak). Box count and room count not explicitly asked. Nearly all seven items covered or inferred from context; classified as full.

evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks 'And then did you have any other just questions about anything' — a standard 'any questions?' version, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' framing.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Full. Customer raises two new items (animal mounts/taxidermy, 10-foot kayak). Rep digs in on each: For taxidermy: 'Like the am Medaris kind of things... Yes, no, we can move those things... we just can't, you know, mount them or anything like that.' For kayak: 'I mean, I've got a kaya like a ten foot kayak but I was gonna plan on moving that myself...' Rep responds: 'Of course, yeah, if this is pretty much all the furniture that you have more or less... if it can fit then yeah, we'll definitely slide it on up in there.' evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' after the animal mounts and kayak are covered. Moves to final confirmation without a catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asks plainly: 'would you like to go ahead and at least reserve that truck?' No softening, no built-in out like 'or I can just email this over.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. Rep states: 'It is free to reserve the truck and it's also free to cancel.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms: arrival window (8:00–8:30), date (November 7th, Saturday), truck with lift gate, confirmation email. Missing: explicit phone number confirmation, full address verification (only origin address fully confirmed; destination address implied but not re-stated), crew size (mentioned '2 movers' in estimate but not re-confirmed at booking). Three of five items fully confirmed; classified as partial.

top_strength: Rep executed strong discovery upfront (address, moving day, apartment details, special considerations, access/parking) and handled customer's late-stage concerns about animal mounts and kayak with genuine follow-up rather than dismissal.
coaching_note: Rep skipped the foundational quid pro quo framing ('Great, we have availability, this takes 10–15 minutes, you walk away with a quote you can depend on') and never asked 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing — two high-value moments to build confidence and permission that were left on the table; add those pauses back in.
